name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan O'Malley's journey into motorsport was a bit unorthodox, starting not on the track but in the engineering workshops of Dublin. After completing his degree in mechanical engineering, he initially worked on heavy machinery before a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited his passion for speed. He quickly transitioned, offering his expertise to smaller outfits before catching the eye of Allied Racing. 

Declan is a firm believer in data-driven decisions and fostering a collaborative environment. He approaches his role with a focus on long-term strategic goals, ensuring every department works in sync to achieve maximum efficiency and performance. His knack for spotting talent and nurturing innovation makes him a valuable asset to any racing team. He emphasizes clear communication and believes a happy team is a fast team.

What sets Declan apart is his ability to see the bigger picture while also staying grounded in the technical details. He possesses an uncanny ability to anticipate problems before they arise, coupled with a talent for motivating his team to overcome challenges. His experience and calm demeanor make him a steady presence in the high-pressure world of motorsport.
